english: Śiva has said, “One who has happened to have a look of Kṛṣṇa, has undoubtedly taken a look of mine for both of us have one image beyond any doubt and there is no difference between me and Kṛṣṇa. (Hence) it is the duty of one to visit Dvārakā for the purpose of taking a look of Kṛṣṇa after having a look of mine. A look of Kṛṣṇa following a look of mine results in superior fruits. If a human soul purified by having a look of Kṛṣṇa takes a look of mine, that human being can never re-enter the cycle of rebirth with his retreat from the heavenly world of Viṣṇu.”
